title: The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
subtitle: Memorial · Rv 11:4-12; Lk 20:27-40
text: An ancient tradition says Mary's parents brought her as a small child to the Temple in Jerusalem to be dedicated to God. Before any angel came to her, she had already given herself to Him. Offer God one hour of your day, freely.
imageAlt: A Renaissance painting of a little girl in a blue dress with a halo climbing wide stone temple steps toward a high priest, while a crowd of Venetian onlookers gathers below and an old woman with a basket of eggs sits at the foot of the stairs.
credit: Titian, Presentation of the Virgin at the Temple, 1534-1538, Gallerie dell'Accademia, Venice. Photo by José Luiz, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
